Title: BookingSheet Crash on Submit Due to API Envelope Mismatch
Impact: 100% of customer bookings crash with TypeError on order.id
Acceptance Criteria: Tapping Book Driver successfully navigates to /dispatch without JavaScript errors

Title: Driver Offer Acceptance Flow Missing in workers/api
Impact: Drivers never receive job offers; orders auto-assigned without consent
Acceptance Criteria: Driver receives 15s incoming offer ring and must actively accept before assignment

Title: Client-Side Mock Payments in Bill Screen with Competitor VPA Leak
Impact: Total revenue leakage; customers ride free; competitor branding d4m@ybl exposed
Acceptance Criteria: Payment cryptographically verified server-side before receipt screen unlocks

Title: In-Transit Order Events Endpoint Missing (/orders/:id/events 404)
Impact: Drivers cannot add tolls or parking to fares or report no-shows
Acceptance Criteria: Added tolls and parking persist and update final trip fare

Title: Universal Backdoor OTP 1234 in Production Trip Verification Handler
Impact: Anyone can enter 1234 to start trips without rider consent
Acceptance Criteria: Submitting 1234 fails with 400 unless 1234 is the genuine generated OTP

Title: Hardcoded SMS OTP 123456 in Auth Routes Without SMS Gateway
Impact: Account takeover on any customer or driver phone number
column16: Only genuine randomly generated OTP dispatched via SMS can authenticate user

Title: Dispatch Screen Polling Desynchronization (EN_ROUTE_TO_PICKUP vs ASSIGNED)
Impact: Riders stranded on searching radar if WebSocket drops during matching
Acceptance Criteria: Polling immediately forwards rider to /trip/live when order is ASSIGNED

Title: Missing Authorization Check on Order Cancellation Endpoint
Impact: Any user can cancel any active trip across the city via IDOR
Acceptance Criteria: Canceling another user's order returns 403 or 404

Title: Unauthenticated Spoofable X-Admin-Role Header in Admin Portal
Impact: Privilege escalation; any user can send header to approve documents
Suggested Workstream: Requests with spoofed headers without valid session cookies return 401

Title: Hardcoded Fallback Customer UUID in Edge Order Creation Route
Impact: Anonymous users can flood platform with phantom orders
Acceptance Criteria: Anonymous POST to /orders returns 401 Unauthorized

Title: Disconnected Driver Onboarding Pipeline & KYC Document Review API
Impact: Drivers cannot upload KYC documents; admins cannot approve drivers
Acceptance Criteria: Driver uploads DL photo to R2 and admin approves applicant from web queue

Title: Competitor Artifacts & Branding Leaks (d4m@ybl and DriverforU)
Impact: Legal risk and brand confusion from Drivers4Me competitor name
Acceptance Criteria: Zero occurrences of d4m or DriverforU across all client bundles and DB

Title: Missing Driver Offer Expiry & Stale Order Auto-Reassignment in Cron
Impact: Orders remain stuck in ASSIGNED if driver phone dies
Acceptance Criteria: Dead driver orders automatically reset to CREATED and re-offer to next driver

Title: Scheduled Booking Lead-Time Dispatch Unconnected in Edge Backend
Impact: Future bookings are dispatched immediately as on-demand rides
Acceptance Criteria: Bookings >30m in future save as SCHEDULED and trigger dispatch at T-15m

Title: Hardcoded Driver Stats & Mock Earnings Endpoints in Edge API
Impact: Every driver sees identical fake earnings (Rs 38000 withdrawable)
Suggested Workstream: Earnings dynamically reflect sum of completed trips minus platform commission

Title: Missing Driver Wallet Debit Ledger Balance and Payout Rails
Impact: Platform cannot disburse earnings; cash commissions never collected
Acceptance Criteria: Driver initiates withdrawal and funds transfer via IMPS/UPI within 60s

Title: 80% of Admin Operations Dashboards 404 Against Cloudflare Worker API
Impact: Ops team cannot inspect drivers riders disputes or tickets
Acceptance Criteria: All core admin tabs load live data without HTTP 404 errors

Title: Zero Automated Test Coverage in Edge Backend (workers/api and cron)
Impact: Extreme regression risk; edge changes can break matching silently
Acceptance Criteria: Vitest test suite runs in CI and passes with >75% coverage on core routes

Title: Missing Idempotency Key Handling on Webhook and Ledger Deduplication
Impact: Retried webhooks insert duplicate credit ledger entries
Acceptance Criteria: Retried webhooks do not create duplicate ledger entries in database

Title: Driver Duty Lacks Native Anti-Fraud Probes (Mock GPS and Spoof Apps)
Impact: Fraudulent drivers can spoof GPS location to steal surge or trips
Acceptance Criteria: Driver cannot toggle ONLINE if mock location provider is active on Android

Title: Odometer & Fuel Checkpoint Photos Ignored by Edge Backend
Impact: Disputes over fuel or mileage cannot be resolved with photo proof
Acceptance Criteria: Start and end odometer photos persist in R2 and link to order record

Title: Unimplemented Driver Fatigue & Mandatory Rest Enforcement
Impact: Exhausted drivers can drive indefinitely without mandatory breaks
Acceptance Criteria: Drivers online >10 hours are forced offline for mandatory 6-hour rest

Title: Driver App Missing Native Floating Overlay Status Bubble
Impact: Drivers must switch back and forth between Google Maps and Vahanly
Acceptance Criteria: Floating overlay bubble displays active fare and status over navigation apps

Title: Missing In-App Chat Integration Between Driver and Rider
Impact: Drivers and riders cannot text within app; forced to make phone calls
Acceptance Criteria: In-app messages exchange in real-time over OrderStreamDO WebSockets

Title: Missing Outstation Multi-Day Booking Rules & Driver Allowance
Impact: Outstation trips lack overnight driver bata rules and return toll fees
Acceptance Criteria: Outstation bookings automatically include driver overnight allowance
